name: Kontainer File Picker
author: Jesper Sandberg

sections.description:
Pull assets like images, videos, and product sheets straight from Kontainer into your WordPress media library.

The app allows downloading templates, which reformat images as they are fetched, and naming templates that can automate SEO optimization. Find out more here at Kontainer Helpdesk.

Read more about the WordPress integration on Kontainer website.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact us at support@kontainer.com.
sections.installation: After installing the plugin, go to Settings and set the Kontainer URL.
